suite: fixed Bot conversation AREA (folder) + conversation rotation + built-in Hindsight memory

conversationArea.meaning: Bot conversations live in one dedicated workspace folder titled 「Bot 对话区」 (configurable path via DSH Settings -> Bot -> 默认工作区). It holds MULTIPLE conversations; when one no longer fits the model context a new conversation starts in the same area instead of deleting history.

rotation.trigger: last prompt totalTokens >= NISSE_BOT_ROTATE_TOKENS (default 90000; test used 2000)
rotation.turn2: new session bf3ecc4e… conversationIndex=2 (completed) — old conversation stayed in the area

longTermMemory.runtime: Hindsight API server (local pg0 + local embeddings/reranker, loopback only) + product MemoryAdapter sidecar, both started/stopped by the desktop shell
wiring: shell MemoryRuntime starts Hindsight + sidecar before the Host profile is composed and publishes memoryUrl/memoryToken into the managed profile layer
host integration injects a Hindsight digest into each new conversation prompt
every completed turn writes an episode (user + assistant text) to memory through the adapter (sensitive screening inherited)
Bot settings -> 记忆: enable switch, runtime status, search, export, clear
